text:
RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: 5

The panel was all women and the person appointed was a woman — so was you. An all-female panel cannot plausibly have favoured a woman over you on grounds of sex. Raising it would signal that you're looking for a grievance rather than feedback, and in a small civil service that reputation travels.

The real issue is the unanswered request. Chase it: send a polite follow-up to the chair and HR, cite any applicable deadline for giving written reasons, and ask specifically how the criteria were scored.

"Experience of leading international projects" suggests the panel weighted a criterion you may not have evidenced strongly. That's the thing worth probing — and worth fixing before the next competition.
